# Getting to Scarra in August

Three ways to reach the island for our week there. The prices are for the four of us: two adults and two children (8 and 11).

## Harbourline car ferry

- Price: £212 return on foot, or £308 return with the car (the car is £96 of that).
- Crossing: 1 hour 50 minutes from Kirkby, leaving at 08:15 and 16:30 every day in August.
- Luggage: no limit if we take the car. On foot, each person may bring one bag up to 20 kg plus a small bag for the cabin, and bicycles cost £6 each way.
- Cancellation: full refund up to 48 hours before sailing. After that we get a voucher valid for 12 months, minus a £10 fee per booking. If we miss the boat there is no refund at all.

## Skerry Air (small plane)

- Price: £540 return.
- Crossing: 25 minutes from the Kirkby airstrip, up to six flights a day when the weather allows.
- Luggage: 15 kg each including hand luggage, soft bags only. Extra bags are £12 each if there is room on the plane, and bicycles are not carried.
- Cancellation: full refund if Skerry Air cancels for weather. If we cancel, we get half back up to 7 days before the flight and nothing after that.

## Tidewater passenger boat

- Price: £176 return, on foot only (no cars).
- Crossing: 1 hour 10 minutes from Kirkby, leaving at 10:00 and 17:45, and it does not run on Wednesdays.
- Luggage: two bags per person up to 25 kg each, with a free trolley on the pier. No bicycles.
- Cancellation: full refund up to 24 hours before sailing and half after that. A sailing cancelled for a force 6 wind or worse is refunded in full.
